parameters.name: Listeners
parameters.description:
The port forwarding rules that you want to configure.

This parameter is a string that is a transform of a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array represents a created port forwarding rule. You can configure a maximum of one port forwarding rule at a time.

> You can call [DescribeNetworkRules](~~157484~~) to query all created port forwarding rules.

Each port forwarding rule contains the following fields:

- **InstanceId**: string. Required. The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
- **Protocol**: string. Required. The forwarding protocol type. Valid values: **tcp**, **udp**.
- **FrontendPort**: integer. Required. The Redirection Port.
- **Remark**: string. Required. The remark. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and some special characters such as `,.+-*/_`. The value can be up to 200 characters in length.
